name: Voltron Nevera
description: Europe's fastest roller coaster, themed around the Rimac Nevera electric hypercar. This record-breaking ride reaches extreme speeds with multiple launches and inversions.

name: Silver Star
description: One of Europe's tallest and fastest steel roller coasters, built by B&M. A classic hypercoaster with airtime hills and sweeping turns.

name: Blue Fire Megacoaster
description: A launched steel coaster by Mack Rides featuring a powerful electromagnetic launch and four inversions through a futuristic industrial theme.

name: Wodan Timburcoaster
description: A thrilling wooden roller coaster themed around Norse mythology. One of the best wooden coasters in Europe with intense airtime and fast turns.

name: Eurosat – CanCan Coaster
description: An indoor roller coaster inside a giant dome, themed around Paris and the Moulin Rouge. Enjoy a lively can-can soundtrack while twisting through the dark.

name: Poseidon
description: A water roller coaster themed around the Greek god of the sea. Combine the thrill of a coaster with the splash of a water ride through ancient ruins.

name: Atlantica SuperSplash
description: A classic log flume adventure through the lost city of Atlantis. Expect big drops and a guaranteed soaking on this family-favourite water ride.

name: Arthur – In the Minimoys Kingdom
description: A magical indoor dark ride and roller coaster hybrid based on the Arthur and the Minimoys films. Perfect for families with younger children.

name: Pirates in Batavia
description: A classic boat dark ride through colonial Batavia under pirate attack. Completely rebuilt in 2020 with modern animatronics and stunning scenery.

name: Euromir
description: A unique spinning roller coaster taking guests on a journey through a Soviet space station. Riders face backwards as their car rotates through the scenes.

name: Alpenexpress Enzian
description: A classic alpine mine train roller coaster winding through the Austrian-themed area. A gentle but fun ride suitable for the whole family.
